svg.title: AIQUBITS open-source orbit and contribution crab
svg.desc: Top external projects by commits in merged pull requests: salvo-rs/salvo plus 2, move-cn/letsmove plus 3, tokio-rs/axum plus 5, cloud-hypervisor/cloud-hypervisor plus 1, conflux-fans/conflux-bounties plus 27, OneBlockPlus/polkadot-hackathon-2025 plus 24, IntensiveCoLearning/Ethereum-Protocol-Fellowship plus 2, OneBlockPlus/polkadot-hackathon-2024 plus 6, boxlite-ai/boxlite plus 2, OneBlockPlus/polkadot-mini-hackathon-2026-03 plus 4. Hover or focus a project to pause the orbit; activate it to open the GitHub repository. Below, a crab travels between and consumes active days in the GitHub contribution calendar for aiqubits.
